title: GTA6 Extended Look Runtime and PS5 Footage Confirmed
description: Netflix has revealed the runtime for the Grand Theft Auto 6 Extended Look broadcast and confirmed it features PlayStation 5 captured footage, according to IGN.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Extended Look Runtime Revealed with Confirmed PS5 Footage

As the anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece continues to reach unprecedented heights, new details regarding the game's promotional rollout have emerged. According to a recent report by IGN, Netflix has officially revealed the runtime for the upcoming *Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look* broadcast, while also confirming a detail that console players have been eagerly waiting to hear: the footage was captured directly on the PlayStation 5.

### What We Know About the Extended Look

The announcement, highlighted by IGN, brings fans one step closer to seeing more of what the highly anticipated open-world epic has to offer. While previous reveals have given audiences a cinematic glimpse into the return to Vice City, the confirmation of a dedicated *Extended Look* broadcast adds a new layer of excitement.

Furthermore, the explicit confirmation that the broadcast features footage captured on the PlayStation 5 is a significant detail for hardware enthusiasts and gamers alike. As players eagerly debate how current-generation consoles will handle the massive scale, advanced physics, and detailed graphics of *GTA6*, seeing native PS5 footage provides a tangible benchmark for the game's technical execution and visual fidelity on the platform.

### Building Momentum for Rockstar's Next Big Title

Rockstar Games has always managed to capture the industry's undivided attention with its calculated and impactful marketing strategies. By partnering for broadcasts like the *Extended Look* via platforms such as Netflix, the publisher continues to feed the massive appetite of the gaming community without overwhelming them with unverified leaks or premature details.

As the broadcast date arrives, fans around the world will be meticulously analyzing every second of the footage for clues about the game's mechanics, world density, and overall polish.

### Editor's Take

The confirmation of PS5-captured footage in the *Extended Look* broadcast is a welcome update for the *GTA6* community. It shifts the conversation from purely cinematic teasers to actual hardware performance. While we await the full broadcast, this news reassures fans that the project's technical showcase is moving forward in a transparent and exciting manner.
